api: topologies.training.losses:get_loss('crps')(logits_or_prediction, targets, *, ignore_index=None, reduction='mean', **params); prediction[..., 0] is mu and prediction[..., 1] is sigma
description: Positive-oriented Gaussian CRPS for scalar Normal forecasts: sigma * (z * (2 * Phi(z) - 1) + 2 * phi(z) - 1 / sqrt(pi)), where z = (target - mu) / sigma (Gneiting & Raftery (2007), §4.2, Eqs. (20)–(21)); validation and reduction conventions follow src/topologies/implementations/losses/berhu.py:4-38.

examples.title: Train a Gaussian regressor with CRPS

name: Gaussian CRPS loss

parameters.additional parameters: **params accepts no additional parameters; unsupported keys raise ValueError
parameters.ignore_index: must be None because continuous targets are not indexed classes
parameters.logits_or_prediction: floating-point tensor shaped [..., 2] with final axis [mu, sigma]; sigma must be finite and strictly positive
parameters.reduction: none returns target-shaped values, mean averages all elements, or sum totals them (default mean)
parameters.targets: floating-point tensor shaped [...] matching prediction.shape[:-1], with matching dtype and device
